authorization: The original user request authorizes one test evaluation after model and evaluation protocol freeze.

signal.resampling: scipy.signal.resample_poly(up=147,down=160), then append 20 right-side zeros to length 256
signal.time_zero: unaligned; preserve measured delay through common resampling

evaluation.directions: all measured ARI directions excluding frozen ARI-adapted Q26
evaluation.solid_angle_weights: SphericalVoronoi areas on the 1524 evaluation directions, normalized to sum one; Q26 weights are zero
evaluation.horizontal_rule: evaluation directions with measured elevation_deg exactly zero within absolute tolerance 1e-9; expected count 86
evaluation.contralateral_rule: 25-degree great-circle caps centered at azimuth 270,elevation 0 for left ear and azimuth 90,elevation 0 for right ear; intersect evaluation set and normalize each cap's weights

metrics.FullSphereERB: AKerbError([50,22050], fs=44100) on strict reconstructed/reference HRIR; solid-angle direction mean per ERB band, band mean, equal-ear mean
metrics.Contralateral25ERB: same AKerbError definition restricted to frozen ear-specific contralateral caps
metrics.ERBBandILDMean: repository spectral_band_ild_profile on 86 horizontal evaluation directions and registered 200--18000 Hz ERB centers
metrics.ITDWeightedMAE: repository estimate_itd_seconds; direction-weighted absolute error over 1524 evaluation directions in microseconds
metrics.FullSphereLSD: frequency RMS dB error, equal-ear mean, solid-angle weighted over 1524 evaluation directions

evaluation.grid_comparability_note: ARI and SONICOM use different measured direction grids and evaluation weights; absolute values must not be pooled as one experiment.

statistics.method_summary: mean and sample standard deviation across 22 subjects
statistics.bootstrap_interval: 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles of paired-subject resampled mean differences; numpy.default_rng PCG64; linear quantiles
statistics.claim_decision_rule: The ARI replication supports FSC residual compensation only if all five preregistered metrics have FSC-MCA mean differences below zero and paired-bootstrap 95% upper bounds below zero; otherwise it does not meet the strict replication criterion. This rule is frozen before any raw test Data.IR access.

test_access_policy: Raw test Data.IR is read once after atomically claiming test_access_state. Later stages read derived HDF5 only. Existing claim or target refuses execution; failure is recorded and automatic rerun is forbidden.
